title: 第15章 孙红霞洗澡第16章 恶人公公
content_zh:
叶开来到孙红霞家门外，孙红霞扛着铁锨走出来，看见叶开，高兴地说：“小开，你来的正好，跟嫂子一起种西瓜去。”
“不是已经种过了吗？”
“还有你家的西瓜没种啊。”
“我家的地不是被张有权霸占了吗？”
“还回来了。”
“啥时还的？”
“刚刚张有兵过来说的，我想赶紧去把西瓜种了。”
张有兵是张有权的堂弟，现任副村长。
张有权不在的时候，村里事情就由张有兵说了算。
桃花村的村委会就是张家兄弟的二人转。
叶开估计是王艳跟张有兵说的，看来这娘们说话算话。
叶开很高兴，“走，种地去！”
两人来到地里，这块地前几天刚犁过，还是叶开和王艳一起梨的，当时叶开还心疼呢，没想到又回来了。
叶开心情很爽，干活也快了很多。
两人一个挖土，一个栽瓜苗，配合默契。
天黑时，活就干完了。
两人收了工往回走，走着走着，叶开感觉不对，这不是回村的路。
他提醒孙红霞：“嫂子，咱们是不是走错路了？”
“没有错，嫂子干了一下午的活，身上都是汗，想洗个澡。”
孙红霞的眼睛盯着叶开身上看，叶开穿的汗衫是纯棉的，已经被汗水湿透了，贴在身上，显出了健硕的肌肉。

被孙红霞一说，叶开也感到身上粘糊糊的很难受。
“是呀嫂子，我身上也是汗，我也想洗个澡。”
“咱们一起洗吧。”孙红霞的声音微微颤抖。
“好呀！”叶开加快了脚步。
桃花山脚下有一条河，河水是从山上流下来的泉水，清澈见底。
两人来到河边，这时的芦苇已经长得一人高了，是天然的屏障。
经常有人在这里洗澡，或者约会。
晚风吹来，芦苇哗啦啦地响着。
孙红霞的心也被吹得荡漾起来，她感到自己浑身发烫，脸上更像火烧的一样。
两人来到岸边，钻进芦苇丛里。
孙红霞叮嘱道：“小开，你转过脸，不要看。”
叶开很听话地转过身子，孙红霞脱去衣服，走进水里。
“嘶！”好凉爽呀！
孙红霞整个人都钻进水里，这才冲叶开说：“嫂子好了，你下来吧。”
叶开转过身，刚想下水，突然听见有人往这边走来，他赶紧蹲下身子。
content_en:
Ye Kai came to the door of Sun Hongxia's house. Sun Hongxia walked out with a shovel. When she saw Ye Kai, she said happily: "Xiao Kai, you came just in time. Let's go plant watermelons with my sister-in-law."
"Hasn't it already been planted?"
"And your watermelons haven't been planted yet."
"Isn't my land occupied by Zhang Quan?"
"It's back."
"When did you pay it back?"
"Zhang Youbing just came over and said, I want to plant watermelons quickly."
Zhang Youbing is Zhang Quanquan's cousin and the current deputy village chief.
When Zhang Youquan was away, Zhang Youbing had the final say in matters in the village.
The village committee of Taohua Village is the duo of the Zhang brothers.
Ye Kai was probably told by Wang Yan and Zhang Youbing. It seemed like this bitch kept her word.
Ye Kai was very happy, "Let's go farming!"
The two came to the field. This land had just been plowed a few days ago, and Ye Kai and Wang Yan peared it together. Ye Kai was still distressed at the time, but he didn't expect it to come back again.
Ye Kai felt very happy and worked much faster.
One of them dug the soil and the other planted melon seedlings, working together in perfect harmony.
When it gets dark, the work is done.
The two finished their work and walked back. As they walked, Ye Kai felt something was wrong. This was not the way back to the village.
He reminded Sun Hongxia: "Sister-in-law, are we going the wrong way?"
"That's right. My sister-in-law has been working all afternoon. Her body is sweaty and she wants to take a shower."
Sun Hongxia's eyes were fixed on Ye Kai. The sweatshirt Ye Kai wore was made of pure cotton and was soaked with sweat. It stuck to her body and showed off her strong muscles.
When Sun Hongxia said this, Ye Kai also felt sticky and uncomfortable.
"Yes, sister-in-law, I'm sweating too, and I want to take a shower too."
"Let's wash together." Sun Hongxia's voice trembled slightly.
"Okay!" Ye Kai quickened his pace.
There is a river at the foot of Peach Blossom Mountain. The river water is spring water flowing down from the mountain, and it is crystal clear.
The two came to the river. At this time, the reeds had grown as tall as one person, forming a natural barrier.
People often take a bath or go on dates here.
The evening breeze blew and the reeds rustled.
Sun Hongxia's heart was also blown up. She felt that her whole body was hot, and her face was more like a fire.
The two came to the shore and got into the reeds.
Sun Hongxia warned: "Xiao Kai, turn your face and don't look."
Ye Kai turned around obediently, and Sun Hongxia took off her clothes and walked into the water.
"Hiss!" It's so cool!
Sun Hongxia's whole body got into the water, and then she said to Ye Kai: "Sister-in-law, please come down."
Ye Kai turned around and was about to get into the water when he suddenly heard someone walking this way and he crouched down quickly.
